data.gender_notes: Shivansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shivansh is derived from two Sanskrit words - Shiva and Ansh. Shiva is the supreme God in Hinduism, the god of destruction and regeneration, and Ansh means 'essence' or 'manifestation'. Thus, Shivansh can be interpreted as the divine grace or the manifestation of God. The name Shivansh carries the meaning “God's Grace, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shivansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine blessings of Lord Shiva.
data.etymology: Shivansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
